turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. The zero on Owen's essay goes in the gradebook, and I find out from my son's phone. Explain that.
I didn't come to be thanked. I asked you a question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'm sorry. This is my third parent meeting today. I'm thinking of quitting teaching.
That's not Owen's problem. Fifteen minutes, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
I just don't know if I can do this anymore.
I'm sorry you're tired, but my son's mark is what we're here for. I'm waiting, Hale. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
